review.actual_content: This Agreement is made between The Riverside Hotel, PQR, located at 987 Lakeview Ave, PQR 560011 (the “Hotel”) and SkyFleet Airways, Inc., located at 2410 Horizon Park, Suite 400, Austin, Texas 78701 (the “Airline”). review.comment: Full legal names and addresses for both hotel and airline are provided; Aurora is named as administrator.

review.actual_content: The initial Term commences on April 1, 2022 and continues for twenty-four (24) months.

review.actual_content: The initial Term commences on April 1, 2022 and continues for twenty-four (24) months. Thereafter the Agreement renews month-to-month.
review.comment: End date is March 31, 2024, per 24-month term; then renews month-to-month.

review.actual_content: The quoted rate is based on a thirty-two (32) hour length of stay and is on a last-room-availability basis. No blackout dates shall apply to scheduled crew operations.
